question: Which open standards does the product read and write for catalogue records, glossaries, quality results, lineage and data contracts? Give versions.
Can we export everything, including custom fields, history, owners, classifications, comments and links, at any time, in open formats, without supplier help or extra charge?
Describe a round trip, exporting our catalogue as DCAT and re-importing it into another product. What is lost?
Does the product support the government Metadata Exchange Model for critical data assets?
Is every object and action in the user interface available through a documented API? Provide the OpenAPI description.
List each connector, who builds and maintains it, its licence and price, and how quickly it follows new versions of the connected system.
Which connectors exist for other suppliers' catalogues, quality tools, lineage tools and records systems?
Does the product emit and accept OpenLineage events? Can it read ODCS data contracts?
What rate limits, call charges or tier limits apply to APIs and events?
Confirm that metadata, glossary terms, quality rules, scores, lineage and any content the product derives from our data belong to us.
In what form are quality rules held? Can they be read and run outside the product?
Can we keep data contracts and rules in our own code repository and have the product read them from there?
Give separate prices for each capability, and confirm we can stop any one at renewal without penalty.
Model the price at today's volumes and at three and five times them.
Which features, connectors, single sign-on or provisioning sit in higher tiers?
What does exit involve, how long does it take, what support is included, and what does it cost, including any cloud egress?
Are licence prices the same on any cloud or on our own infrastructure?
Does the product use our identity provider for sign-in and automated user provisioning, at no extra charge?
Can classification and access policies be read by other tools?
If the product includes AI features, where are prompts and answers processed and stored, are they used to train models, and can they be switched off?
Can an assistant we already approve query the product through an open protocol, respecting the same access rules?
Name customers who use the product with another supplier's catalogue, quality or lineage tool, and how they connect them.
Will you take part in a short proof of concept using our data and an interoperability test we define?
